description: Repairs r-str-ado-act/ado-session: the connections ran in read mode (Mode = 1), confounding the cursor and lock results. On two read-write ACE connections (own copy of r-fix-wire-ado-ado5): two Recordsets (keyset read-only of K, forward-only read-only of J) and a Command (ActiveConnection set by reference, CommandText SELECT * FROM D) on the first, each ActiveConnection read (object identity captured); a failing Execute on the second connection with both Errors collections read right after; then the first connection is closed and the State of each Recordset, the Command's ActiveConnection and State and the second connection's State are read. Asks whether the objects share one Connection and what Close leaves.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-wire-ado probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
